title: Audience Return Cities from Repeated Setlists
dataSources: Practice sessions (`practice:session`), DAW sessions (`daw:session`), release/streaming stats (`release:stats`), gig setlists (`setlist:play`).
app: Music and creator telemetry — practice-tracker apps (Modacity), DAW project logs, and streaming/creator analytics (Spotify for Artists, YouTube Studio) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=setlist:play city=*
| stats count as songs_played, dc(show_id) as shows by city
| sort - shows
description: Shows which cities see you repeatedly enough to suggest an audience worth nurturing.
value: Repeated city appearance is a simple proxy for where live momentum may actually be building.
implementation: Track show and setlist events with city fields in `index=personal`; summarize repeated appearance by city.
visualization: City table of shows played and songs performed.
grandmaExplanation: It checks which cities keep seeing your shows often enough that a real returning audience may be forming.
